comment: Wolfenstein 3D plane-0 wall codes 1..63 -> our wall textures 1..8 (walls.png: 1 server rack, 2 cable tray, 3 brick, 4 vent, 5 Iris mural, 6 monitor wall, 7 pipes, 8 exit sign strip). Code N uses VSWAP wall pages 2N-2 (light) and 2N-1 (dark). Names for codes 1..23 follow the released game; names above 23 are approximate (WL6/SOD only, the shareware episode uses few of them). Codes not listed use 'default'. Code 21 is the elevator switch wall: it stays a wall; the elevator door (plane 0 codes 100/101) becomes the E exit door.

families.name: grey stone
families.comment: the plain castle wall, the most common code; maps to the default server rack

families.name: grey stone, decorated
families.comment: banner (3) and eagle arch (6): the Iris mural takes the place of the decorations

families.name: grey stone, portrait
families.comment: Hitler portrait: a monitor wall instead

families.name: blue stone cells
families.comment: prison cells, empty (5) and with skeleton (7): barred look -> vent grille

families.name: wood, decorated
families.comment: wood with eagle (10), portrait (11), iron cross (23): Iris mural

families.name: entrance / elevator
families.comment: level entrance frame (13), elevator switch (21), fake elevator (22): exit sign strip

families.name: steel
families.comment: steel plate with sign (14) and plain steel (15): pipes

families.comment: red brick, plain and with wreaths/eagle: brick
